title: Microsoft Teams: private chat for organisers and presenters in webinars and structured meetings (GCC High and DoD)
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and the Microsoft documentation checked. It distinguishes the planned GCC High and DoD chat from documented town hall attendee chat, and accurately identifies the remaining gaps in feature-specific controls, defaults and licensing.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Scope
claims.claim: Meeting chat is reached in Teams admin center at Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting engagement > Meeting chat.
claims.quote: go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select the policy you want to edit. ... Go to the Meeting engagement section. ... Set Meeting chat to your chosen value

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled turns off meeting chat for users assigned the policy.
claims.quote: To turn off meeting chat for users with this assigned policy, run the following command: ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Admins can control whether participants in their users' meetings and events with up to 1,000 attendees can read and send chat messages.
claims.quote: As an admin, you can control: Whether participants in your users' meetings and events with up to 1,000 attendees can read and send chat messages.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The general meeting chat control covers webinars with up to 1,000 attendees.
claims.quote: Chat in events with up to 1,000 attendees, such as webinars, uses the same experience as chat in Teams meetings. ... As an admin, you can control whether participants in your organizers' events with up to 1,000 attendees can read and send chat messages.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Meeting chat Off corresponds to Disabled and turns meeting chat off for all participants.
claims.quote: Off | Disabled | Meeting chat is turned off for all participants; organizers can't use their Allow meeting chat to turn on chat in their meetings. Organizers can't override this setting.

claims.quote: This setting doesn't apply to channel meetings and is a per-user and per-organizer policy.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not state whether the Meeting chat policy also governs the separate event group chat.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: Town hall attendee meeting chat messages are stored only in an organiser's mailbox.
claims.quote: Meeting chat messages in events optimized for large audiences, excluding the event group chat, are stored only in an organizer's mailbox for up to 30 days.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: The documented town hall attendee-chat mailbox storage period is up to 30 days, subject to the stated legal-hold exception.
claims.quote: are stored only in an organizer's mailbox for up to 30 days. ... However, if you place the organizer's mailbox on legal hold, the mailbox keeps the chat messages for longer.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The event group chat is explicitly excluded from the separate town hall attendee-chat storage rule.
claims.quote: Meeting chat messages in events optimized for large audiences, excluding the event group chat, are stored only in an organizer's mailbox for up to 30 days.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: Placing the organiser's mailbox on legal hold keeps the town hall attendee-chat messages for longer.
claims.quote: However, if you place the organizer’s mailbox on legal hold, the mailbox keeps the chat messages for longer.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Microsoft documents Teams chat compliance copies in hidden folders in chat participants' mailboxes.
claims.quote: Behind the scenes, Exchange mailboxes are used to store data copied from these messages. Data from Teams chats is stored in a hidden folder in the mailbox of each user included in the chat

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Compliance administrators can search the Teams chat data in those hidden folders with eDiscovery tools.
claims.quote: These hidden folders aren't designed to be directly accessible to users or administrators, but instead, store data that compliance administrators can search with eDiscovery tools.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: No source states that this change alters existing webinar or meeting chat behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams 'event group chat' webinar structured meetings GCC High DoD policy disable automatic license price; 'event group chat' webinars. Read roadmap, Manage chat for Teams events and Manage chat in Microsoft Teams meetings; no replacement or change to existing chat was stated.
